event_summary: 1945年9月26日、ハンガリーから亡命し困窮の中にあったベーラ・バルトークがニューヨークで白血病のため死去した。葬儀の参列者はわずか10人ほどで入院費もASCAPの慈善支援で賄われるほどだったが、数年後には作品が世界的に再評価され20世紀を代表する作曲家と称されるようになった。
hook_copy: たった[R]10人[/R]の葬儀から、数年後には[G]20世紀最高[/G]と呼ばれた
portrait_prompt: Portrait illustration of Béla Bartók, Hungarian composer, based on his well-known 1940s photographic portraits (such as the 1943 New York portrait). Gaunt, ascetic face with sharp, angular features; high receding hairline with thinning grey-white hair combed straight back close to the scalp; deep-set, intense dark eyes under strong brow ridges; prominent straight nose; thin, tightly pressed lips giving a serious, austere expression; pale, careworn complexion showing fatigue and illness. He wears a plain dark suit jacket with a white dress shirt and a simple dark necktie, no jewelry, no decoration, understated and modest as in his actual photographs. Bust-to-shoulder composition, facing slightly to the side toward the viewer. Plain muted solid-color background (soft neutral grey-brown). Illustrated cinematic style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. No text of any kind. Artwork fills the entire canvas edge to edge, no border, no frame, no vignette, no empty margin at the edges.

middle_slides.text: 1945年9月、故郷ハンガリーを追われ亡命先ニューヨークで貧困と病に苦しんでいたベーラ・バルトークが、白血病のため息を引き取った。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly and not photorealistic, of an emaciated, gaunt Béla Bartók lying in a modest hospital bed in a sparse 1945 New York hospital room, dim and lonely light through a small window. He has a high receding hairline with thin grey-white hair swept back, deep-set dark eyes, sharp angular face, pale sickly complexion, wearing a plain white hospital gown or simple nightshirt. His eyes are closed, face peaceful in death, hands resting on the blanket. The room is bare and modest, reflecting poverty and exile, with a single dim lamp casting somber shadows. Muted, desaturated color palette of greys and browns. No text, no other people prominently featured, focus entirely on Bartók.

middle_slides.text: 葬儀に参列したのはわずか10人ほど。入院費や葬儀代は、音楽著作権団体ASCAPの慈善支援でようやく賄われるほど、生活は困窮していた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly and not photorealistic, of a small, sparse funeral gathering in a modest New York chapel in 1945, viewed from a respectful distance so that only a handful of mourners (about ten silhouetted figures) sit scattered among empty pews. A plain wooden coffin sits at the front beneath dim, grey autumn light filtering through a window. Emphasize the emptiness and solemnity of the near-vacant hall. Bartók himself is not shown as a visible figure among the mourners since he is deceased; instead his framed portrait--a gaunt man with receding grey-white hair swept back, deep-set eyes, sharp angular ascetic face--rests near the coffin. Muted, cold color palette of greys and dark blues conveying poverty and quiet grief. No text.

middle_slides.text: しかしその死からわずか数年後、遺された作品群は世界中で再評価され、いまや彼は"20世紀最大の作曲家"の一人と称されている。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly and not photorealistic, symbolic scene of Béla Bartók's musical legacy triumphing after his death: in the foreground, faint and translucent like a memory, the gaunt figure of Bartók with his high receding hairline of thin grey-white hair swept back, deep-set eyes, sharp angular ascetic face, seen from the side facing away in three-quarter profile toward light streaming from the top of the frame, hands as if once holding a pen over manuscript paper covered with musical notation. Around and above him, warm golden light rays radiate outward suggesting worldwide fame and rediscovery, subtly evoking concert halls and admiring crowds in soft impressionistic background silhouettes without depicting a distinct modern audience literally. Rich warm color palette contrasting with darker earlier scenes, symbolizing his rise to being called one of the 20th century's greatest composers. No text, only Bartók as the composer figure.

fb_caption:
1945年、ニューヨークでひっそりと世を去った音楽家がいた。葬儀の参列者はわずか10人ほどだったが、数年後にはベーラ・バルトークの作品が世界的に再評価され、20世紀を代表する作曲家と称されるようになった🎻

「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

他の作曲家の逸話も知りたい方は、チャンネルもチェックしてみてください。https://youtube.com/@classicalmusic_note?si=evg6wej2KOx2uPhH
